categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: aerospace military products, sensing and control products, intelligent transportation, and other related products. It focuses on aircraft measurement and control products, power distribution products, hanging and delivery systems, strain gauges, strain sensors, weighing instruments and software, intelligent sensors, consumer electronics, intelligent logistics equipment, industrial weighing control, vehicle inspection, special vehicle inspection, intelligent driver training, intelligent traffic information systems, ZOS management software, and electromagnetic valves.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages intelligent measurement and control core technologies, including advanced sensing technologies such as strain gauges and sensors, electromagnetic valves, and digital weighing systems. It employs integrated design and manufacturing capabilities with international advanced technology levels, emphasizing R&D in intelligent thin-film sensors, high-precision multi-component balances, UAV cargo delivery systems, and digital operation management systems (ZOS). The company also focuses on AI-enabled robotics sensors and industrial automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include aerospace and defense sectors, industrial measurement and control industries, intelligent transportation authorities, and consumer electronics markets. The company serves both military and civilian aviation sectors, with significant sales to domestic and international markets. Major end markets include national defense modernization, low-altitude economy applications, new energy vehicle inspection, medical and environmental sensing, and digital industrial transformation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales accounting for about 75% of revenue and international sales around 25%. It has offices and production facilities in Shaanxi, Sichuan, Hebei, and other provinces, with expanding overseas markets. The company also benefits from the Belt and Road initiative and global aviation market growth, serving customers worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace and industrial sensing supply chains. It manufactures core components, integrated systems, and provides solutions for aircraft measurement and control, sensing devices, and intelligent logistics. It also engages in system integration and software development, positioning itself as a key supplier and solution provider in aerospace and industrial automation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening aerospace main business, expanding sensing and control technologies, developing intelligent transportation solutions, and fostering digital and AI-driven industrial upgrades. The company invests over 10% of revenue in R&D, focusing on new product development such as UAV cargo delivery systems, intelligent thin-film sensors, and digital operation management platforms. It aims to enhance core competitiveness through innovation, international certification, and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products and systems, including aerospace military products, sensing and control devices, and intelligent transportation equipment. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts often involving milestone payments. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to technology development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the Chinese aerospace measurement and control industry, supported by strong R&D capabilities and extensive product certifications. It competes with other domestic aerospace and sensing equipment manufacturers, leveraging its integration with the China Aviation Industry Corporation (AVIC) group. The company benefits from high entry barriers in aerospace manufacturing and maintains competitive advantages through innovation and quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.78 billion, a 6.11% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 112.3 million, up 14.41%. Total assets reached RMB 4.24 billion, growing 6.69% from the previous year. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with increasing R&D investment and expanding market share domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, reliable, and cost-effective intelligent measurement and control solutions tailored for aerospace and industrial applications. It differentiates itself through integrated design and manufacturing, extensive international certifications, and a broad product portfolio covering military and civilian sectors. Its commitment to innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric solutions enhances its competitive edge and market responsiveness.
